digest.component_or_area: code review gate, project criteria routing
propositions: A new hard fail CI gate or required pipeline step with no if-present/grandfather guard can break branches created before the gate was added.
Project code-review criteria are currently dispatched unconditionally without reference to applies_to glob matching against changed files.
An advisory project.ci-gate-compat criterion should be triggered declaratively via CI-agnostic glob patterns against pipeline config files rather than hardcoded language specific paths.
The applies_to glob set for a criterion must be overridable by a config key (ci_config_globs) so projects can declare unusual pipelines without code changes.
The criterion should ask whether a pipeline/gate-configuration change introduces a hard fail step with no grandfather guard, CI-vendor agnostically.
